newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures expand gains late, end up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures expand gains late, end up.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures leapt up late in the day to end with sizable gains but just off highs.
Traders tied the the final hour's bounce partly to the ability of U.S. Treasury bond futures to shave some losses and close above session lows.
T-bond futures had briefly visited afternoon lows after the Treasury's auction of $8 billion of inflation-protected 10-year notes drew slightly less demand than expected.
Some floor brokers also noted unconfirmed talk that a prominent strategist had said the stock market's 10-percent downward correction was over and that more gains lie ahead.
Traders said the late day rise caught some intraday players on the wrong side, prompting weak shorts to bail out as futures advanced.
"It was a question of everybody being short on the day trade," said one floor broker in S&P 500 futures.

He said the premium of June S&P 500s over cash also expanded enough to attract some small arbitrage buy programs before the Dow 30 Industrial Average rose 50 points and triggered the New York Stock Exchange's curb on computer-assisted index arbitrage trades.
Fair value Tuesday was about 5.80 points over cash.
Arbitrage buy programs would have needed about 6.40 points premium or more.
But brokers said sellers steeped in near the highs, blocking the rise before nearby S&Ps challenged what some pegged as the next key level at 777.00, last week's high.
"The correction could go further," said another floor broker. "Into the end of the week, we could see 777.00."

Futures early had tracked T-bonds lower after some economic data proved stronger than forecast. They also noted a wire service story that suggested the March core consumer price index could show more strength than in February.
CPI is due April 15. The producer price index due Friday is seen unchanged overall and the core rate up 0.1 percent.

June S&P 500s rose 4.75 points to 772.05, Value Line rose 3.30 to 697.10, Nikkei 225 rallied 345.0 to 18,095.0, Midcap 400s gained 1.70 to 258.50, NYSE Composite rose 2.55 to 405.50, Russell 2000 added 0.95 to 349.00, and Nasdaq 100 rallied 11.20 to 851.50.
